name: Facets Content type or Other
description: Provides a Search API / Facets facet that indexes node content types as first-order values plus a single 'Other' catch-all bucket, with configurable per-type labels and sort order.
project_description: Facets Content type or Other lets a site index node content types into a facet where some types are kept as their own ("first-order") values and every other type is folded into a single "Other" bucket, keeping content-type facets tidy on sites with many bundles. It ships a Search API processor (id 'content_type_or_other', class ContentTypeOrOther) that adds a computed 'content_type_or_other' string property to the index: at index time it maps each node's bundle to its configured label override, or to 'Other' when the bundle is not marked first-order (or to the plain bundle label when no first-order types are configured). A companion Facets sort processor (id 'content_type_or_other_sort', class ContentTypeOrOtherSortOrder) orders the facet results by the configured first-order sequence and always pushes 'Other' last. An admin form (SettingsForm) at /admin/config/search/facets-content-type-or-other (permission 'administer facets') provides a draggable table to pick which content types are first-order, override each label, and set the sort weight, storing everything in the facets_content_type_or_other.settings config object. A SetIndexedValue event (name 'facets_content_type_or_other_set_indexed_value') is dispatched right before each value is indexed so other modules can subscribe and compute a custom label from the node entity. The module owns no routes beyond the settings form, no permissions of its own, no entities, no config schema and no Drush commands. Content re-indexing is required after configuration changes.
